changes: Every Read/Observe/Act has a separate in-memory request gate; exact notification cancellation retires that request without revoking the page grant. Existing global withdrawal and stdout barrier remain.
Mac FFI starts receive a process-unique nonzero operation ID. Rust drop, timeout or closed result channel queues exact native retirement; no direct Box free after accepted start.
One absolute eight-second deadline includes initial main-thread queue wait. Native receiver retirement is separate from execution completion, which may occur later or never.

Windows uses the same owner and a detached occupied slot with optional receiver; manual/navigation invalidation and request cancellation do not admit overlapping execution. Only exact actual completion removes the pending slot; close destroys the view.
Unknown noncontrol results no longer claim permission was stopped. Control result-channel loss keeps structured unknown. No automatic retry introduced.
